    Method: USGS method

References: Wilson, L.R., "An evaluation of of digitally derived K-indices",
            J. Geomag. Geoelectr. (1987) 39, 97-109.
  
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

                              Files on diskette:

usgs.zip        Numerous files within directories containing the Fortran
                source code for the USGS method of computing K-indices,
                in compressed (by PKZIP version 2.04) format.  To 

                To de-compress usgs.zip use the provided PKUNZIP with the
                -d option, ie    pkunzip -d usgs

                The file DKTXT.T51 within the compressed file is a
                WordPerfect document file describing the USGS program.

dktxt.txt       An ASCII text translation of the file DKTXT.T51.  This file 
                does not contain the figures as in the WordPerfect file and
                has been jumbled to some extent in the translation.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                End of file
